nodes.label: Patient 3 Profile Photo (Pixelated Green Game Character)
nodes.description: Patient profile photo for patient ID 3. Image shows a pixelated, pixel-art style green character (resembling a Minecraft Creeper) against a light green background. Used as a placeholder or actual patient avatar in the AshaSathi backend system.

nodes.label: Patient 4 Profile Photo (Young Adult Male)
nodes.description: Patient profile photo for patient ID 4. Shows a young adult male with short brown hair and a beard, wearing a dark maroon/burgundy t-shirt, photographed against a plain white/light grey background. Appears to be a standard headshot-style profile photo.

nodes.label: Patient 5 Profile Photo (Pixelated Green Game Character)
nodes.description: Patient profile photo for patient ID 5. Image shows a pixelated, pixel-art style green character (similar to a Minecraft Creeper) against a light green background. Very similar to patient 3's profile photo, likely the same placeholder image used as a default avatar.

nodes.label: Patient 6 Profile Photo (Young Adult Male)
nodes.description: Patient profile photo for patient ID 6. Shows a young adult male with short brown hair and a beard, wearing a dark maroon/burgundy t-shirt, photographed against a plain white/light grey background. Appears identical to patient 4's profile photo, likely a shared placeholder image.

nodes.label: App Background Image (Blank/Empty)
nodes.description: Background drawable resource for the AshaSathi Android app. The image appears to be nearly blank or a very minimal white/near-white image with no visible content or design. Likely used as a plain background layer in the app UI.

nodes.label: AshaSathi Android 12 Splash Logo (HDPI)
nodes.description: Android 12 splash screen logo for AshaSathi at HDPI density. Displays the brand logo: bold green text reading 'ASHA' on top with 'SATHI' beneath in slightly smaller text. The letter 'A' in 'ASHA' incorporates a stylized house icon with a small window inside, forming a home/roof shape. The entire design uses a single green color on a white background, conveying themes of home, health, and community.

nodes.label: AshaSathi Splash Screen Logo (HDPI)
nodes.description: Main splash screen logo for AshaSathi Android app at HDPI density. Identical design to the android12splash variant: bold green branding text 'ASHA SATHI' with a house-shaped icon integrated into the letter 'A', white background. Single-color green palette.

nodes.label: AshaSathi Android 12 Splash Logo (MDPI)
nodes.description: Android 12 splash screen logo for AshaSathi at MDPI density. Same brand logo as HDPI variant but sized for medium-density screens: 'ASHA SATHI' in bold green with house icon in the 'A', white background. Slightly more compact rendering due to lower density.

nodes.label: AshaSathi Splash Screen Logo (MDPI)
nodes.description: Main splash screen logo for AshaSathi Android app at MDPI density. Identical brand design to other splash variants: 'ASHA SATHI' bold green text with integrated house/home icon in the 'A', white background, MDPI screen density.

nodes.label: AshaSathi Android 12 Splash Logo Night/HDPI
nodes.description: Night-mode Android 12 splash screen logo for AshaSathi at HDPI density. Displays the same 'ASHA SATHI' brand logo with green text and house icon, white background. Intended for use in Android dark/night mode, though the visible design appears the same as the standard light-mode variant.

nodes.label: AshaSathi Brand Logo
nodes.description: The AshaSathi brand identity: bold green text 'ASHA SATHI' with a house/home icon incorporated into the letter A, symbolizing a health companion and home care application. Green color palette conveys health, growth, and care.

nodes.label: AshaSathi Patient Profile System
nodes.description: The AshaSathi backend stores patient profile photos in a per-patient directory structure under Backend/uploads/patients/{patient_id}/profile.jpg. Patients 3 and 5 use a pixel-art game character placeholder; patients 4 and 6 use the same real headshot photo, indicating shared placeholder images.
